Foundry Fonts

The approved Foundry mockups with only the two typefaces changed: Source Sans 3 in the place of Signika (everything read: names, labels, buttons, numbers) and Source Serif 4 in the place of Cinzel (big titles such as the character's name). The book uses the same two. Colors, sizes and layout are untouched.

The PC sheet (dark)

How it was made: copies of action-card-dark.html, chat-cards-dark.html and pc-sheet-dark.html with their embedded Signika and Cinzel replaced by the book's font files under the same names, then photographed. In the system the change is two font files shipped with it and the names in the stylesheets.
